item.title: No Vector Store: a 25.87 MiB SQLite Index Reaches 86.62 Recall@10
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. The semantic call can wait until after the question arrives. Keep words and counts in the index, and MuSiQue R@10 moves from 54.41 to 86.62 on a 2.36-second build with no model calls. The paper is SAG2: Embedding-Free Multi-Hop Retrieval with BM25 and JEV, by Yuchao Wu at Zleap AI, arXiv 2610.

item.title: The Ontology Divide Is Not Model Size
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. Between December 2025 and November 2026, six papers closed in on one conclusion from three directions. The bottleneck in ontology construction moved from who can write an ontology to who can prove the written thing is right. Every number below goes back to a named section or table. Two minutes twenty-three, voiced in English, captions burned in and switchable in the player.

item.title: Retrieval as Navigation: DecisionRAG Asks a Tree Instead of Scoring a Corpus
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. The bottleneck in retrieval is not the size of the candidate pool. It is what you let the model see, and in which order. DecisionRAG replaces scoring with asking, and returns a 65.4 top-1 hit over 2.68M passages in 1.7 seconds. It also loses three cells, plainly. English voiceover, 3 minutes 12 seconds.

item.title: The Database Got a New User: Record Stores and Context Layers for Agents
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: the database’s main user stopped being a person, so it grew a second leg — one that holds state and provisions on demand, one that supplies context and compiles it ahead of the query. What really changed is the definition of retrieval: from a recall algorithm to an orchestration frame plus a compiled supply.
